title: outreach_draft
description: Shared by draft_initial_outreach and draft_followup. facts_asserted is cross-validated in code: every anchor_id must exist in the prospect profile, or the draft is rejected before it can be queued for approval.

subject.description: Lowercase or sentence case. No colons-as-headline, no clickbait.

word_count.description: Not model-supplied. complete_json() computes this from `body`'s real word count and injects it before validation — a generous sanity floor/ceiling only; the actual per-prompt limit (e.g. draft_initial_outreach.md's 120-word rule) is enforced by V2 in core/llm.py, not by this bound.

facts_asserted.description: Every claim the email makes about the prospect, each tied to an anchor. An empty array means the email asserts nothing specific about them.
